Either the trade happened off-app and index.html needs updating, or it's still pending — seventeen straight reviews is well past the point of this being a live decision rather than a stale one. The board still declared an interim dividend of Rs 1.75/share (17.5%) on top of the Rs 2.00/share (20%) already paid this year — yield is intact for now, ex-date confirmed Mon Aug 10, 2026 (payment Sep 3, now 5 days out).
